title: The Day of the Lord, Repentance and Restoration
description: A powerful prophecy about the terrifying Day of the Lord that brings destruction, yet leads to deep repentance and God's merciful restoration of the land and people. [ref:Joel 2:1-11|Joel 2:1-11] describes the mighty army and the day of judgment, [ref:Joel 2:12-17|Joel 2:12-17] calls for heartfelt repentance with fasting and prayer, and [ref:Joel 2:18-27|Joel 2:18-27] promises full restoration of the years consumed by locusts.
